features.name: log_impression_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed impression count normalized by training mean log impression, capturing exposure intensity on a smooth scale suitable for linear margins
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew in impression distribution, providing smooth continuous signal for SVM hyperplane separation

features.name: position_depth_ratio
features.description: Ratio of ad position to search depth, measuring how prominently the ad appears relative to total depth of results shown
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative prominence of ad placement; lower ratio indicates better visibility, useful linear feature for SVM

features.name: top_position_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the ad appears in position 1, the most prominent placement
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct linear signal for top-position ads which typically have higher engagement rates

features.name: shallow_depth_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for search depth of 1, meaning only one result was shown, indicating high relevance context
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures high-relevance search contexts where fewer results are shown, useful binary feature for linear SVM

features.name: impression_log_sqrt_composite
features.description: Composite of log and sqrt transformations of impression count, providing a smooth severity measure of ad exposure frequency
features.expected_model_benefit: Blended transformation reduces extreme outlier influence while preserving monotonic ordering for linear separation

features.name: ad_id_normalized
features.description: Ad ID normalized to [0,1] range using training min/max, serving as a proxy for ad recency or campaign ordering
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth normalized ad identifier signal that may correlate with ad campaign characteristics

features.name: advertiser_id_normalized
features.description: Advertiser ID normalized to [0,1] range using training min/max, capturing advertiser ordering as a continuous feature
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized advertiser identifier may encode systematic differences in advertiser quality or category for linear models

features.name: keyword_log_normalized
features.description: Log-normalized keyword ID capturing keyword space position on a smooth scale, useful as a proxy for keyword category
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous representation of keyword space position for linear SVM feature weighting

features.name: content_id_alignment_score
features.description: Normalized absolute difference between title and description IDs, measuring content component alignment as a coherence proxy
features.expected_model_benefit: Content coherence signal; aligned title-description pairs may indicate higher quality ads with better engagement

features.name: user_id_log_normalized
features.description: Log-normalized user ID providing smooth continuous representation of user space position as a proxy for user segment
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth user identifier encoding that may capture systematic behavioral differences across user segments for linear models

features.name: placement_quality_score
features.description: Weighted composite of position and depth signals: higher score for top positions in shallow searches, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite placement quality metric combining position and depth into one linear-friendly continuous score

features.name: ad_content_diversity_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of ad content diversity based on the spread between keyword, title, and description IDs relative to their respective ranges; higher values indicate more diverse content components which may signal broader targeting
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures semantic diversity of ad content components as a continuous score useful for linear SVM margin optimization
